title: eucosia afzelii
intro: Eucosia afzelii, commonly known as the African pepper, is a flowering plant in the family Annonaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits including relief from coughs, colds, and fever due to its expectorant properties. It also has therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, which contribute to its use in treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Eucosia afzelii include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
